reviews.comment:
Sinceramente terminamos almorzando ahí de casualidad & que GRAN sorpresa nos llevamos!!! La comida es congelada (se nos indicó en el momento) pero estaba riquísima.

Tema aparte la atención: el personal es atento y MUY MUY amable. Una chica y un chico nos tuvieron mucha paciencia (éramos varios) y fueron muy cálidos, con una GRAN sonrisa.

Para rematar, llegó la encargada del lugar y WOW, la misma buena predisposición de antes y más.

Pongo 5 estrellas pero se merecen mil!!!!

(Translated by Google)
We honestly ended up having lunch there by chance, and what a wonderful surprise! The food was frozen (we were told this at the time), but it was delicious.

The service was outstanding: the staff was attentive and incredibly friendly. A young woman and man were very patient with us (there were several of us) and were very welcoming, with big smiles.

To top it all off, the manager arrived, and wow, she was just as helpful and even more so than before.

I'm giving it 5 stars, but they deserve a thousand!
